```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(magrittr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(readxl)
library(knitr)
library(patchwork)
library(ROCR)
library(pROC)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE
)

options(scipen = 999)

data.f <- "FACS_data.xlsx"

facs.df <- read_excel(data.f, "facs data") %>%
  filter(!is.na(`Batch number`)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(`Responder Group`)) %>%
  mutate(Response = ifelse(`Responder Group` == "A", "R", "N")) %>%
  mutate(Response = factor(Response, levels = c("R", "N"))) %>%
  mutate(Treatment = ifelse(`Treatment group (grey)` == 20, "20Gy", "24Gy")) %>%
  mutate(Timepoint = str_extract(`Batch number`, ".+(?= B)")) %>%
  mutate(Timepoint = factor(Timepoint, levels = c("Baseline", "Cycle 1", "Cycle 3"))) %>%
  mutate(`Lines of chemo in metastatic setting` = ifelse(`Lines of chemo in metastatic setting` == 0, "No", "Yes")) %>%
  mutate(`Lines of chemo in metastatic setting` = factor(`Lines of chemo in metastatic setting`, levels = c("No", "Yes")))

facs.df

# p value formatter
pformat <- function(p) {
  if (p < 0.0001) {
    "<0.0001"
  } else {
    as.character(signif(p, 2))
  }
}

p_label_thresh <- function(p, threshold = 1e-4) {
  if (!is.finite(p) || is.na(p)) return("NA")
  if (p <= 0) return('"<" * 10^{-308}')

  if (p < threshold) {
    e <- floor(log10(p))
    m <- signif(p / 10^e, 2)
    m_str <- sub("\\.?0+$", "", format(m, trim = TRUE, scientific = FALSE))
    sprintf("%s %%*%% 10^{%d}", m_str, e)
  } else {
    as.character(signif(p, 2))
  }
}

```

## Figure 3

### (A) CD3

```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=3}

baseline_cb.df <- facs.df %>%
  filter(grepl("Baseline", `Batch number`, fixed = T)) %>%
  filter(Clinical_Benefit %in% c("Y", "N")) %>%
  mutate(Clinical_Benefit = factor(Clinical_Benefit, levels = c("Y", "N")))

baseline_cb_n.df <- baseline_cb.df %>%
  group_by(Clinical_Benefit) %>%
  tally %>%
  mutate(Clinical_Benefit_n = paste(Clinical_Benefit, "\n(", n, ")", sep = ""))

cd3_cb.p <- baseline_cb.df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Clinical_Benefit, y = `T cells`, fill = Clinical_Benefit)) +
  ggdist::geom_dots(layout = "weave", binwidth = grid::unit(c(1.5), "mm"), overflow = "compress", side = "both", show.legend = F, linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey50") +
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "crossbar", width = 0.5, fatten = 1.5, color = "black", show.legend = F) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#b2abd2", "#fdb863")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), breaks = seq(from = 0, to = 100, by = 20)) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = baseline_cb_n.df$Clinical_Benefit_n) +
  labs(x = "", y = "% CD3+ cells") +
  ggsignif::geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("Y", "N")), margin_top = 0.2, vjust = -0.1, textsize = 3.0, test.args = list(exact = F)) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 8, colour = "black"),
        axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10))

cd3_cb.p

baseline_cb.df %>%
  wilcox.test(formula = `T cells` ~ Clinical_Benefit, exact = F, data = ., conf.int = T) %>%
  broom::tidy(.) %>% mutate(across(where(is.double), ~ signif(.x, digits = 2)))

```

### Fig 3 layout

```{r fig.height=6, fig.width=10}

fig3_row1 <- (cd3_cb.p | cd8_cb.p | cd4_cb.p) * theme(plot.margin = unit(c(0, 20, 0, 0), "pt")) | ratio_cb.p

fig3_row1 <- fig3_row1 + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") & theme(plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold"))

fig3_chemo_block <- cowplot::ggdraw(((cd8pd1_chemo.p | cd4pd1_chemo.p) * theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), plot.margin = margin(l = 20, b = 10)))) +
  cowplot::draw_label("Prior treatment for advanced\ndisease",
             x = 0.6, y = 0.02, vjust = 1, fontface = "bold", size = 10)

fig3_row2 <- ((cd8pd1_cb.p | cd4pd1_cb.p) | fig3_chemo_block) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(2, 2, 5)) + plot_annotation(tag_levels = list(c("E", "F", " G"))) & theme(plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold"))

cowplot::ggdraw(fig3_row1) / cowplot::ggdraw(fig3_row2)

```

## Figure 4

### (A) CD8 PD-1 timecourse

```{r fig.height=4, fig.width=3}

timecourse.df <- facs.df %>%
  filter(Patient %in% baseline_cb.df$Patient) %>%
  mutate(Timepoint2 = case_when(Timepoint == "Baseline" ~ "RT-",
                                 Timepoint == "Cycle 1" ~ "RT+",
                                 Timepoint == "Cycle 3" ~ "C3",
                                 TRUE ~ NA_character_)) %>%
  mutate(Timepoint2 = factor(Timepoint2, levels = c("RT-", "RT+", "C3")))

timecourse_n.df <- timecourse.df %>%
  group_by(Timepoint2) %>%
  tally %>%
  mutate(labs = paste(Timepoint2, "\n(", n, ")", sep = ""))

cd8pd1_bl_c1.df <- facs.df %>%
  filter(Timepoint != "Cycle 3") %>%
  filter(Patient %in% baseline_cb.df$Patient) %>%
  dplyr::select(Patient, Timepoint, `CD8:PD-1`) %>%
  spread(Timepoint, `CD8:PD-1`, fill = NA) %>%
  with(wilcox.test(Baseline, `Cycle 1`, paired = T, exact = F, conf.int = T)) %>%
  broom::tidy(.) %>% mutate(across(where(is.double), ~ signif(.x, digits = 2))) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Baseline v Cycle 1") %>%
  mutate(p.value2 = p_label_thresh(p.value))

cd8pd1_c1_c3.df <- facs.df %>%
  filter(Timepoint != "Baseline") %>%
  filter(Patient %in% baseline_cb.df$Patient) %>%
  dplyr::select(Patient, Timepoint, `CD8:PD-1`) %>%
  spread(Timepoint, `CD8:PD-1`, fill = NA) %>%
  with(wilcox.test(`Cycle 1`, `Cycle 3`, paired = T, exact = F, conf.int = T)) %>%
  broom::tidy(.) %>% mutate(across(where(is.double), ~ signif(.x, digits = 2))) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Cycle 1 v Cycle 3") %>%
  mutate(p.value2 = p_label_thresh(p.value))

cd8pd1_tc.p <- timecourse.df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Timepoint2, y = `CD8:PD-1`, fill = Timepoint2)) +
  ggdist::geom_dots(layout = "weave", binwidth = grid::unit(c(1.5), "mm"), overflow = "compress", side = "both", show.legend = F, linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey50") +
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "crossbar", width = 0.5, fatten = 1.5, color = "black", show.legend = F) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 65), breaks = seq(from = 0, to = 60, by = 20)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#fbb4b9", "#f768a1", "#c51b8a")) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = timecourse_n.df$labs) +
  labs(x = "", y = "% CD8+ PD-1+") +
  ggsignif::geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("RT-", "RT+"), c("RT+", "C3")), margin_top = 0.2, textsize = 3.0, vjust = -0.2, step_increase = 0.15, annotations = c(cd8pd1_bl_c1.df$p.value2, cd8pd1_c1_c3.df$p.value2), parse = T) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 8, colour = "black"),
        axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
        strip.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10))


cd8pd1_tc.p

bind_rows(cd8pd1_bl_c1.df, cd8pd1_c1_c3.df)


```

### (C) Tpex

```{r fig.height=4, fig.width=5.5}

cb_all.df <- facs.df %>%
  filter(Patient %in% baseline_cb.df$Patient) %>%
  mutate(Clinical_Benefit = factor(Clinical_Benefit, levels = c("Y", "N"))) %>%
  mutate(Timepoint2 = case_when(Timepoint == "Baseline" ~ "RT-",
                                 Timepoint == "Cycle 1" ~ "RT+",
                                 Timepoint == "Cycle 3" ~ "C3",
                                 TRUE ~ NA_character_))

cb_tp_n.df <- cb_all.df %>%
  group_by(Clinical_Benefit, Timepoint2) %>%
  tally %>%
  mutate(Clinical_Benefit_cycn = paste(Clinical_Benefit, "\n(", n, ")", sep = "")) %>%
  ungroup %>%
  group_by(Timepoint2) %>%
  arrange(Clinical_Benefit, .by_group = T)

# Shared x-axis labels across timepoints (defined once, reused in D and E)

C1_labs       <- cb_tp_n.df %>% filter(Timepoint2 == "RT+") %>% pull(Clinical_Benefit_cycn)

tpex_bl.p <- cb_all.df %>%
  filter(Timepoint == "Baseline") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Clinical_Benefit, y = `CD8:PD1+ TCF1+ (Tpex)`, fill = Clinical_Benefit)) +

  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "crossbar", width = 0.5, fatten = 1.5, color = "black", show.legend = F) +

  scale_x_discrete(labels = baseline_labs) +
  labs(x = "", y = "% CD8+PD-1+TCF1+") +
  ggsignif::geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("Y", "N")), margin_top = 0, vjust = -0.2, textsize = 3.0, test.args = list(exact = F), y_position = 50) +
  facet_wrap(~Timepoint2) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 8, colour = "black"),
        axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
        strip.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10))
```

```{r fig.height=3.5, fig.width=3}
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "crossbar", width = 0.5, fatten = 1.5, color = "black", show.legend = F) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#5ab4ac", "#a6611a")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 55), breaks = seq(from = 0, to = 50, by = 10)) +
  labs(x = "Prior treatment for\nadvanced disease", y = "% CD4+PD-1+") +
  facet_wrap(~Treatment, scales = "free_x") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 8, colour = "black"),
        axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 8),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 10)),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
```

## Tumour TILs and clinical benefit analysis

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

facs_tils.df <- baseline_cb.df %>%
  mutate(TILs = as.numeric(`Tumour TILs`)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(TILs)) %>%
  mutate(CBF = factor(Clinical_Benefit, levels = c("N", "Y"))) %>%
  dplyr::select(Patient, TILs, CBF, Clinical_Benefit)

# ROC analysis (DeLong test via pROC)
proc_obj <- facs_tils.df %>%
  mutate(CBF2 = as.numeric(CBF)) %$%
  roc(CBF2, TILs)

pred <- facs_tils.df %$%
  ROCR::prediction(TILs, CBF)

# Performance: ROC
perf <- ROCR::performance(pred, "tpr", "fpr")

# Compute AUC
auc <- ROCR::performance(pred, "auc")@y.values[[1]]

# confidence intervals
ci <- pROC::ci.auc(proc_obj)

cat("ROC TILs for Clinical Benefit AUC ")
auc
ci

# Logistic regression
fit <- facs_tils.df %>%
  mutate(TILs_1 = TILs / 10) %>%
  mutate(CBFLR = as.numeric(CBF) - 1) %$%
  glm(CBFLR ~ TILs_1, family = binomial)

# significance
summary(fit)

# Odds ratio with confidence intervals
exp(cbind(OR = coef(fit), confint(fit)))

```
